findings.summary: The 0.1.0 heading has no release date, and the link references for [Unreleased] and [0.1.0] are missing.
findings.evidence: Keep a Changelog normally writes '## [0.1.0] - YYYY-MM-DD' and adds compare links at the bottom. Leaving them out matches the design assumption that no release is tagged yet (docs/design/athena-v0.md:283), so this is acceptable.

summary: The change does what was asked: it starts a changelog. It adds a root CHANGELOG.md in Keep a Changelog form, with an empty Unreleased section and a 0.1.0 section, plus one row in the README map that links to it. I checked every 0.1.0 entry against README.md, docs/architecture.md, docs/records.md and the crate sources, and each one describes something that exists. Nothing is invented. The change has no secrets or personal data and touches only the two expected files. I ran git status, git diff, cargo fmt --check and cargo test myself, and all came back clean. The only finding is a nit: the 0.1.0 heading has no release date or link reference, which fits the design's assumption that no release is tagged yet. Verdict: pass.
